analysis.title: GS Kaplan - GS Week Ahead 30 Oct 2026
key_insights: S&P 500 implied move through next Friday (11/6) is 1.84%.
Next week is the last major week of Q3 earnings, with AAPL reporting Monday and described as the tech standout.
Focus shifts to the US Midterm Elections on Tuesday, where Kalshi prices 65% odds of a Democratic sweep, and to the jobs numbers on Friday.

The Quarterly Refunding Announcement (QRA) on Wednesday gives tenor details. The desk is watching for any change to issuance or supply levels, with attention on the back end, especially 20-year and 30-year issuance.
GS is hosting a Midterms session on November 4 at 10:15AM EST, 'Views from D.C. and the Trading Floor', with Alec Phillips (Chief US Political Economist) among the speakers.
earnings_insights: AAPL is scheduled to report Monday (11/2) and is described as the tech standout of the last major week of Q3 earnings. The text gives no EPS or revenue estimates, and the earnings table in the PDF did not come through in the extracted text.
